topic_title: How Alcohol and Other Drugs Affect Driving Ability
prompt: How does alcohol consumption degrade an operator's visual capabilities during night driving?

options.text: Enhances nocturnal night vision allowing drivers to see hazards without headlights
Causes tunnel vision, slows pupil recovery from glare, and degrades depth perception
Expands horizontal peripheral vision fields beyond one hundred and eighty degrees
Has zero impact on vision provided the driver wears corrective eyeglass lenses
